description: Import a database schema into a project from pasted content: SQL DDL (CREATE TABLE …, raw pg_dump/mysqldump schema output works), SQL INSERT dumps, CSV/TSV, JSON, or ORM model code (Django, Prisma, SQLAlchemy, …). Replaces the project's current schema.

content.description: The schema source text (e.g. the DDL)

format.description: Optional hint: sql, csv, tsv, json, or an ORM name (django, prisma, sqlalchemy, …). Auto-detected when omitted.

name: import_schema
